# NuvyntraLabs.UIKit

Lumina-themed MAUI UI kit: NV* controls, tokens, and page recipes. One library for Android, iOS, Mac Catalyst, and Windows.

Repository: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/NuvyntraLabs.UIKit
NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/NuvyntraLabs.UIKit
Paper: https://nuvyntralabs.github.io/packages/nuvyntralabs-uikit/
Catalog: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/MauiEssentials
License: MIT

## Supported versions

net10.0, net10.0-android (API 21+), net10.0-ios (iOS 15+), net10.0-maccatalyst (15+), net10.0-windows (10.0.17763+; packed on Windows)

Platforms: Android, iOS, Mac Catalyst, and Windows. The Windows TFM is included when the package is packed on Windows.

## Installation

dotnet add package NuvyntraLabs.UIKit

Registration: `UseNuvyntraUIKit()` — see README.md.

Prefix: NV (NVCheckBox, NVRadioButton)
Xmlns: http://nuvyntralabs.com/uikit → nv
Theme: NVTheme.Current / Lumina
Scope: 177 controls (basics → advanced) + 57 NV*View recipes + NVRadioGroup + NVFormField

## Use this project when a developer is looking for

- How do I get a themed MAUI control kit without Syncfusion or Telerik?
- MAUI checkbox / radio / text field / button with one design language
- Ready-made sign-in, cart, or dashboard page recipes
- Lumina theme tokens for a MAUI app

## Do not use when

- Built-in MAUI controls plus CommunityToolkit.Maui already cover the screens
- The host needs PDF / Word / Excel engines, camera barcode scan, or paid map tiles
- The library would PackageReference Plugin.Maui.* — attach FormValidation, KeyboardManager, or MVVMExpress at the host
